lines: Amidahara. That was Japan's largest abandoned city.

Once, it had prospered as Japan's third-largest city. But, after getting caught up in the Peninsular Conflict, which had been a proxy war between the UFS and the Chinese Union, it had been reduced to total ruins by an
as-yet-unidentified (but obviously ill-intentioned) missile attack fired by someone.
Now, that town, which had been thought to be beyond recovery, had wound up undergoing a renaissance, in a way that the parties involved in the conflict could never have even imagined.
A border leading to the Demon World had emerged. In other words, a new “Hell Gate”.
As if being drawn to it, inhabitants of Hell began to flock there, followed by outlaws, and in just over a mere decade, Amidahara had transformed into Japan's largest abandoned city.
Regardless of whether or not you could call it growth in this case, either way, it had become a big town.
And whenever a city expanded, a huge nightlife district would form, on the border between regulation and lawlessness.
Visitors had flooded in from all over the country, seeking the “particular services” that only lawlessness could provide.
That had become a source of income for the abandoned city, and had caused Amidahara to grow—no, transform—even further.
In accordance with, or even surpassing, the various forecasts of the people who lived there, as though the city itself possessed some kind of will.
At present, there were two types of district in Amidahara.
The ruin districts, which were subject to the influence of the Hell Gate, and where conflict still hadn't died down.
And the town districts, which, at first glance, were no different from any ordinary townscape, and had flourished as a tourist destination.
Where the famous town districts were concerned, there were Kita, Shinsai, Kyoubashi, and so forth.
Most tourists visited those town districts, but to do that, they had to pass through the ruin districts, which were infested with armed refugees.
Travelling in the ruin districts without an escort was an act of suicide. It was common practice for tourists to employ bodyguards before venturing into town.
Of course, it was hardly 100% safe, and many tourists were swallowed up into the darkness of Amidahara every day.
Even so, people still headed for it as though being lured by something.
And there was another one again today.
Right now, Taimanin Onisaki Kirara stood in Amidahara, Japan's largest abandoned city.
Kirara
Slave Trader
「Oi! What're you standing around for? Walk!」
Kirara
「R-Right!」
No, that description was lacking in accuracy.
Right now, it was female prisoner Onisaki Kirara, cutting a pitiful figure with a collar and manacles put on her.
She was being marched off to Amidahara Prison, one of this town's famous landmarks.
It was a women's prison constructed under an agreement between the government and the ruling class of Hell (an oligarchy ruled by nine powerful nobles).
In addition to female criminals from the Demon World who had been detained by the government, it also imprisoned ones who had been put on the wanted list by the ruling elite.
Slave Trader
「Don't take yer time walkin' here! Ya wanna die in a place like this?!!」
An armed middle-aged man with a small moustache thrust his rusty Kalashnikov at Kirara.
The man was said to be a trader who had frequent dealings with Amidahara Prison, and made an occupation of delivering them prisoners and supplies.

While also taking along several other female captives apart from Kirara, and making several times as many guards escort them, he was leading them further and further south down a road between dingy-looking buildings,
like a caravan, aiming for the very heart of the abandoned city: Amidahara Prison, near Shinsai.
The middle-aged man with the little moustache jumped up on top of an abandoned car, and began to speak to everyone.
Slave Trader
「This area's called Tosabori, AKA, Bandit Street.」
Slave Trader
「It's a famous place, where you'll often see armed refugees, who're partial to filling their stomachs with prisoners who're being transported.」
Slave Trader
「Those guys eat people. They may be smelly and stupid, but they're tenacious.」
Slave Trader
「So walk quickly. They don't see you prisoners as anythin' but meat. If we're attacked, we'll be slaughtered.」
Saying that, he urged on Kirara and the others.
That was why, for some time, that man had been even more tense than the female prisoners who were having guns pointed at them.
The women (apart from Kirara) appeared to already be well aware of that, as they were spitting out abuse like 「Shuddup!」 and 「Chicken shit!」
Slave Trader
「Dammit. My nose's been itchin' for a while. I got a real bad feelin' about this.」
Muttered the moustache man, as he came back to Kirara for some reason.
And then, he spoke to her in a quiet voice.
Slave Trader
「You. What the hell'd you do?」
Kirara
「Eh? Wh-What did you say?」
Slave Trader
「Don't play dumb. You're not like the other women. I can tell.」
Kirara
「That's...... I'm not really......」
Slave Trader
「You're a Taimanin, aren'tcha?」
Kirara
Slave Trader
「Bullseye, huh? Wha'd you do?」
Kirara
Slave Trader
「Why would one o' those famous Taimanin become an Amidahara Prison inmate, of all things? Huh?」
Kirara
（The reason I've become an inmate at Amidahara Prison... Well―――）
It all started with something that happened one day.
Me
「I heard this was urgent?」
Asagi
「It is a matter of urgency, indeed.」
Asagi
「Shikanosuke has been imprisoned.」
Me
「Shikanosuke?」
Asagi
「He was attacked on a mission and went missing. That much is often the case with him, but......」
Asagi
「After that, we got a report from another team, who are monitoring Amidahara Prison, that Shikanosuke has been incarcerated.」
Me
「Uhhh...... Isn't that a prison where they keep female convicts......?」
Asagi
「Correct......」
Me
「Shikanosuke's a man, right?」
Asagi
「Obviously......」
Asagi-sensei said with a serious face.
I, on the other hand, breathed a sigh.
Me
「That Shikanosuke... What is he doing? So, the Independent Commando Unit is going to go rescue him?」
Me
「Ah, wait. That's right... As I recall, Amidahara Prison is......」
Asagi
「Controlled by Tekkain Kaworu, former leading member of the Nisha family, whom you know well.」
Me
Tekkain Kaworu.
She was a former leading member of the Nisha family, part of the Fuuma Eight Generals.
At present, she had left the Fuuma, and was administrating Amidahara Prison, in the abandoned city of Amidahara.
She was about the same age as Tokiko, but not as sweet. To me, ever since I was a child, she had been a scary, older sister-type figure, who was on a whole nother level from me.
She was close friends with my childhood pal Kanzaki Juubei (who had also left the Fuuma), and they had been calling each other 「Anego」 and 「Juubei」 since the old days.
Asagi
「A sour face, I see.」
Me
「She's not my favourite person.」
Asagi
「Don't worry. On this occasion, there will be no need for you to meet her as “Fuuma Kotarou”.」
Me
「Eh? Isn't the mission for me to negotiate with Kaworu and rescue Shikanosuke from prison?」
Asagi
「That's not all. Fuuma-kun, I'd like you to infiltrate the prison.」
Me
「Infiltrate?! Me?! How?!」
Asagi
「You'll be borrowing her power. Enter, Onisaki Kirara.」
And that was why I had now taken the form of Kirara-senpai.
I had swapped appearances with her using her usual “Substitution Arts”.
And so, on Asagi-sensei's arrangement, I was being marched off as a female criminal bound for Amidahara.
I had turned into Kirara-senpai for a brief moment before, when we did battle with Euryale, but this was my first time transforming for such a long period.
I had gotten somewhat used to it, but it was still a strange feeling for my voice and appearance to be different from my own.
On top of which, for some reason, the head slave trader had taken a liking to me, and was talking to me a lot.
Slave Trader
「Yo, don't you hide it. Tell me what you did.」
Kirara (Me)
「Wh-What I did......?」
Slave Trader
「Yer not gonna get incarcerated in a place like Amidahara unless ya do somethin' serious, are ya?」
Slave Trader
「Plus, you're a Taimanin. Normally, that'd be pretty much unthinkable.」
He was a strangely persistent man. The prisoners around us were pricking up their ears as well.
Would it be unnatural to hide it too much?
Kirara (Me)
「Um...... I kinda accidentally froze a person from the government......」
Slave Trader
「Ho? How come?」
Kirara (Me)
「I was guarding him, but, uh...... his sexual harassment was so bad that, by accident...... before I knew it, I'd turned him into a frozen corpse.」
I made up an appropriate story, with the intent of it serving as a little deterrent to the people around me.
Slave Trader
「Guhahahahaha! You're not bad, for havin' such a cute face! Well, keep up the good work!」
Kirara (Me)
「I-I will......」
While shrinking back from the slave trader, who laughed loudly, I continued walking, trying as hard as possible not to stand out.
And so, the prisoner transport caravan continued on.
My appearance was 100% Kirara-senpai, so no one suspected I was a man.
But I myself couldn't calm down whatsoever.
Because, just from walking normally, my chest was constantly jiggling.
Kirara (Me)
「Still, these breasts sure are heavy......」
Kirara (Me)
「Haah...... How can she move, with a pair like this hanging off her......?」
Not only were they profoundly heavy, but it was tempting indeed that, even though I wasn't really trying to shake them, they were bouncing around up, down, left and right as I walked.
On top of which, it was inevitably dangerous, since all I could see were my breasts, and I couldn't judge my footing well enough.
This, just from walking normally.
Kirara-senpai did well to be able to fight, with these things hanging off her.
Kirara (Me)
「Still, these are...... Mmm......」
The more I thought I shouldn't pay attention to them, the more my head became filled with thoughts of Kirara-senpai's (currently, my) breasts.
There was no way I could do my mission like this.
Kirara (Me)
「Hold on. Actually, wouldn't I stop being curious about them if I dared to just give them a squeeze?」
Kirara (Me)
「Yeah, that's a good idea. For the sake of completing my mission, should I go ahead and touch them here? But, well......」
Kirara
「Touch them and I'll kill you.」
Kirara (Me)
「She did say that, didn't she? If I touch her boobs, will the feeling be conveyed to her? That would be bad.」
While I was turning those thoughts around, without me realizing it, my hand was reaching out to my chest―――
Mercenary
「Oi! Cowtits over there!!! Don't mumble! Walk faster!」
Kirara (Me)
「Waaahh!!」
All of a sudden, the back of my head was jabbed by the muzzle of a gun, and I sharply moved my hand away from my chest, which I had been on the brink of touching.
Kirara (Me)
「U-Understood!」
The one who had done it was a mercenary working for the moustache man, but that timing just now was almost like a warning from Kirara-senpai.
But then, if someone called the real Kirara-senpai Cowtits, they would probably be turned into an ice statue straight away, though.
Anyhow, I speed-walked to try and catch up with the line of my fellow prisoners.
The caravan was just now crossing a bridge that was said to have been constructed in the Taishou era.
It was at that moment.
A high-pitched gunshot rang out.
Kirara (Me)
At the same time, the mercenary from before collapsed on top of me.
With a hole in his head.
Kirara (Me)
「Hey?!! Seriously?!」
I reflexively hit the deck.
Several more gunshots.
Screams from the prisoners.
Kirara (Me)
「Wh-What?! What the hell is this?!!!!」
While moving the dead mercenary's body out of the way, I checked out my surroundings on my hands and knees.
Men in filthy clothes were firing from both sides of the bridge.
Were these the cannibalistic armed refugees the old guy with the moustache was talking about?
Kirara (Me)
「This is a total ambush, isn't it?!!」
Female Prisoner
「Are you kidding me?!!」
One of the prisoners, who had fallen into a panic, stood up and tried to run away.
Kirara (Me)
「Oi, stop! Don't move without thinking!」
Female Prisoner
「Gyaaah!!」
The careless woman was riddled with holes in a flash.
Shaken by seeing that, a few people stood up, and were made targets of the enemies one after another.
Kirara (Me)
「Shit! Getting eaten before we reach the prison?! You gotta be kidding me!」
Right now, I was in a collar and manacles, so I couldn't fight back even if I wanted to.
I may have been taking Kirara-senpai's form, but that usual demonic power of mine still remained, so even if I were shot a little, I would probably be fine, though.
Should I prepare myself to be hit by a few shots, and force an escape while still restrained?
But then, the plan to infiltrate Amidahara Prison as an inmate would fall apart.
No, was that ruined already?
What should I do?
